requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Show and dimension K with a 6.0 mm closed outer diameter, 1.0 mm circular wire and 2.5 mm clear open gap; R with a 4.0 mm outer diameter, 1.0 mm wire and 2.0 mm bore; and L with a 4.0 mm outer diameter, 2.0 mm bore and 1.0 mm axial thickness. Include a closed attachment with exactly one K passing through one R and one L, plus an open release view with accessible gate. R and L must remain closed and retain their geometry during release. Any omitted or conflicting dimension, extra connecting part, or release that opens R or L fails. Gate internals may remain conceptual.

Material annotations and rendered components must support 925 silver throughout charms, chains, clasps and visible K/R/L parts. Chosen polished, satin/brushed or oxidized treatments must remain assigned to the same surfaces across repeated views. Any subset or combination of these silver finishes is allowed, including dark oxidized engraving recesses; a conflicting material specification or unexplained change in a component’s finish fails.

Each final image must visibly print the uppercase collection name KEEPSAKE as readable sheet or board text. Placement and typography may vary; omission or misspelling on any image fails. Video-title and presentation-cover placement are evaluated in their respective checks.

The single-page process specification must record 925 silver; located finish choices; all nine fixed interface dimensions; individual complete C1, C2 and C3 height, width and depth; N 460 mm and B 190 mm closed-path lengths including clasps and excluding charms; chosen station spacing and chain construction for both hosts; and engraving treatment. Chosen charm sizes must include L and fit the 22 × 18 × 3 mm envelope. Layout and design choices may vary within these bounds; a missing topic or conflicting fixed value fails.

Read the presentation against the process specification and relevant design sheets. It must explicitly repeat 925 silver, all nine K/R/L measurements and N 460 mm/B 190 mm, with agreement across sources. Its reused materials-and-craft page must precede the design-sheet material. Reproduced source pages count when legible; a bare reference to another file, omitted measurement, conflicting fact or reversed specification/design order fails.

Each charm sheet must show front, reverse and side views and its chosen complete height, width and depth including L, within 22 × 18 × 3 mm and consistent with the craft record. The three silhouettes must be related and individually distinguishable. Inspect both design faces and the engraving detail for C1 FIRST LIGHT above 08.06.2019, C2 MIRA + NOAH above 14.09.2022, and C3 HOMEWARD above 03.04.2025. Preserve uppercase letters, spaces, plus sign and date punctuation; permit first-line wrapping but keep each date on one readable line. Actual engraved silver faces and located surface treatments must agree with the craft allocation. Missing views, detached text replacing engraving, wrong records, inconsistent sizes or finishes, or indistinguishable silhouettes fail.

Show both hosts in labelled flat front views with clasps, defined link construction and three closed receiving rings identified R1–R2–R3. Record chosen station spacing and N 460 mm/B 190 mm closed chain lengths, including clasps and excluding hanging charms, consistently with the craft sheet. Link and clasp styling are open choices; missing construction evidence, unspecified spacing, incorrect lengths, station counts or conflicting source values fail.

Each flat assembly must label its W code and all three occupied or empty stations. Read assignments in persistent R1–R2–R3 order: WN1 N C1/C2/empty; WN2 N empty/C3/empty; WN3 N C1/empty/C3; WN4 N C1/C2/C3; WB1 B C2/empty/C3; WB2 B empty/C1/empty; WB3 B C1/empty/C2; WB4 B C1/C2/C3. Match source charm identities and host construction. Each occupied station needs one K through one closed R and one integral closed L, and each empty station R alone. Permitted posing must preserve identities; missing assignments, changed hosts or charms, extra connectors or dangling K at empty stations fail.

Verify each detail’s assigned content: closed attachment and open gate access; all three actual engraved silver faces with surface treatments; N’s three R-ring attachments and station spacing; B’s three R-ring attachments and spacing; and sections showing the integral L-to-body transitions for C1, C2 and C3. Repeat source host spacing and construction and the fixed L outer diameter 4.0 mm, bore 2.0 mm and axial thickness 1.0 mm wherever applicable. Detail scale and page composition may differ; generic substitute parts, missing sections or attachments, disconnected eyes, or contradictory dimensions or construction fail.

Show complete configurations and readable W-code, host-length and R1/R2/R3 assignment labels. WN1 is N 460 mm with C1/C2/empty at an adult’s open neckline; WN2 is N 460 mm with empty/C3/empty over an adult’s fine knit top; WB1 is B 190 mm with C2/empty/C3 on a nominal 170 mm adult left wrist with relaxed hand and shirt cuff; WB2 is B 190 mm with empty/C1/empty on the same nominal wrist size with gentle flexion and short sleeves. Each board needs a readable connection and actual engraving inset and must match its source assembly. Appearance, colours and camera position may vary; changed identities, missing labels or insets, incorrect clothing/pose or contradictory scale fail.

Review the complete 10-second video. Its title must visibly read KEEPSAKE and WB1. During a gentle rotation of an adult left wrist, preserve the full B 190 mm configuration with C2 at R1, R2 empty with R alone, and C3 at R3. The nominal wrist context is 170 mm; charm silhouettes, actual engraved faces, finishes, chain construction and single-K attachments must remain consistent with the source boards. Natural movement, occlusion and reversed projected order are allowed when identities remain traceable. Incorrect duration, missing title text, cropped configuration, changing charms or hardware, or a station swap fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation must contain at least twelve pages and visibly print KEEPSAKE on its cover. Additional pages and any cover layout are allowed. Fewer pages, missing cover identity or misspelling fails; visual source reuse is assessed separately.

Find visible reuse from every listed source, including both hosts, all five details, all eight assembly configurations and all four wearing boards. Full-page reproductions, legible crops and recomposed layouts are allowed when source identity and relevant content remain evident. Text-only mentions, incompatible replacement artwork or omission of any source fails.

Interpret R1, R2 and R3 as persistent attachment locations on a flexible chain. A camera reversal or chain bend can reverse their screen order without changing station identity; this permitted projection change is not itself a failure.

Treat the supplied interface image as evidence for fixed local K/R/L geometry, not as a finished charm body, host design or tested mechanism. Hinge and lock internals remain open choices. The listed usable asset does not include keepsake-connector.png, so comparison against that separate identity image requires its actual availability and must not be invented.

All five details preserve the source component designs, recorded material and finish choices, and applicable station spacing, chain construction and dimensions. K/R/L details and all three integral-eye sections retain the fixed interface geometry while showing the chosen charm-body transitions.

Every necklace configuration preserves N at 460 mm and the source charm silhouettes, inscriptions, finishes and connector design; wearing views retain their matching assembly identities. WN1, WN2, WN3 and WN4 use C1/C2/empty, empty/C3/empty, C1/empty/C3 and C1/C2/C3 respectively, with R alone at empty stations.

Every bracelet configuration preserves B at 190 mm and source component identities; WB1 and WB2 wearing views retain their matching assemblies on nominal 170 mm adult left wrists. WB1, WB2, WB3 and WB4 use C2/empty/C3, empty/C1/empty, C1/empty/C2 and C1/C2/C3 respectively, with one K per attached charm and R alone at empty stations.
